releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.23 — faster and more private. Photos are now resized and compressed before they are sent (a 6 MB camera shot becomes a few hundred KB), their hidden GPS/EXIF data is stripped, and a small thumbnail travels with each picture so chats paint instantly. The chat list also opens from an on-device cache and refreshes in the background. The in-app Server option is gone: the backend is fixed when the app is built, like any other messaging app.
